nodes.name: Webhook — Chat Message
nodes.notes: Called ONLY by the Next.js /api/chat route on the Velure site (server-to-server), never by the browser. Header Auth credential: Name = X-Velure-Secret, Value = a long random string. The same value goes into Vercel env N8N_CHAT_SECRET. Expected body: { sessionId, message }.

nodes.name: Validate & Limit
nodes.notes: Daily caps reset at midnight UTC. Static data is only saved in production executions (workflow active), not in manual test runs.

nodes.name: Check Cache
nodes.notes: Knowledge Base + System Prompt are cached for 10 minutes. After editing them in Notion, changes go live within 10 minutes (or immediately after deactivating/reactivating the workflow).

nodes.name: Get Knowledge Base
nodes.notes: Reads all blocks of 'Velure AI Assistant / Knowledge Base'. Callouts are skipped.

nodes.name: Get System Prompt
nodes.notes: Reads 'Velure AI Assistant / System Prompt'. Only the CODE BLOCK on that page is used.

options.systemMessage:
={{ $json.systemPrompt }}

<context>
Current date and time in Scottsdale (America/Phoenix): {{ $now.setZone('America/Phoenix').toFormat("cccc, LLLL d, yyyy 'at' h:mm a") }}.
Next 8 days: {{ Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => $now.setZone('America/Phoenix').plus({ days: i }).toFormat('ccc yyyy-MM-dd')).join(', ') }}.
</context>

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: The context block appends the current Scottsdale date, so relative dates resolve correctly. Return Intermediate Steps must stay ON: Format Reply reads the suggest_booking result from it.

nodes.name: Claude Haiku
nodes.notes: Same Anthropic credential as the Thaus chat assistant. maxTokensToSample caps reply length (and cost).

nodes.name: Conversation Memory
nodes.notes: Remembers the last 10 exchanges per sessionId. In-memory: cleared when n8n restarts.

parameters.description: Check free appointment times at Velure. Returns free start times per open day (24-hour HH:mm, Arizona time). Call before naming or offering any specific time. Sundays are skipped automatically.

value.date_from: ={{ $fromAI('date_from', 'First date to check, YYYY-MM-DD in Arizona time. Earliest is tomorrow.', 'string') }}
value.days: ={{ $fromAI('days', 'How many open days to check, 1 to 5', 'number') }}

nodes.name: check_availability
nodes.notes: Tool name must stay 'check_availability' (the System Prompt refers to it). After import, pick the 'Velure — Availability' workflow in the dropdown (switch to 'By ID' to confirm a real ID is set), then publish this workflow again. The sub-workflow must be published too.

parameters.description: Show the visitor a Book button that opens the booking panel with the treatment, and optionally the date and time, already filled in. This is the only way to give the visitor a booking link. It does not book anything.

value.treatmentId: ={{ $fromAI('treatmentId', 'Booking id: signature-glow-facial, wrinkle-relaxers, dermal-fillers, collagen-microneedling, laser-rejuvenation, body-contouring or consultation', 'string') }}
value.date: ={{ $fromAI('date', 'YYYY-MM-DD shown as free by check_availability, or empty string', 'string') }}
value.time: ={{ $fromAI('time', 'HH:mm (24-hour) shown as free by check_availability, or empty string', 'string') }}

nodes.name: suggest_booking
nodes.notes: Tool name must stay 'suggest_booking' (the System Prompt refers to it). After import, pick the 'Velure Chat — Booking Link' workflow in the dropdown (switch to 'By ID' to confirm a real ID is set), then publish this workflow again. The sub-workflow must be published too.

parameters.description: Pass a visitor's question to the Velure team, who reply by email within one business day. Call only after the visitor agreed and gave an email address. At most once per conversation unless they correct their details.

value.name: ={{ $fromAI('name', 'Visitor name, or empty string if not given', 'string') }}
value.phone: ={{ $fromAI('phone', 'Visitor phone number, or empty string if not given', 'string') }}
value.question: ={{ $fromAI('question', 'The visitor\'s question in one to three sentences, faithful to their words', 'string') }}

nodes.name: save_contact_request
nodes.notes: Tool name must stay 'save_contact_request' (the System Prompt refers to it). After import, pick the 'Velure Chat — Contact Request' workflow in the dropdown (switch to 'By ID' to confirm a real ID is set), then publish this workflow again. The sub-workflow must be published too.

nodes.name: Format Reply
nodes.notes: Builds { reply, action }. The Book button comes only from a successful suggest_booking call.

nodes.name: Log to Chat Logs
nodes.notes: Runs AFTER the reply is sent, so logging never slows the chat. If logging fails, the visitor is not affected.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ reply: "Sorry, something went wrong on my side. Please try again, or use the contact form below." }) }}
